name: Govt.nz
body: A meta description on every page read, full share cards, Secure cookies, HSTS, and alt text on every image. But the home page HTML took 1.6 to 3.3 seconds to arrive in each read, before any image or script loads.
lesson: Cache the home page HTML at the edge. Good sites deliver it in under 0.8 s.
summary: www.govt.nz scores 83 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 18 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 13 pages have no canonical link.

fix.title: 13 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /browse/immigration-and-visas/, /browse/benefits-pensions-and-financial-support/, /browse/education/, /browse/work-and-tax/ and 9 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 3321 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: 12 pages took longer than 1.8 s
fix.evidence: /browse/benefits-pensions-and-financial-support/ (2196 ms), /browse/education/ (2115 ms), /browse/work-and-tax/ (3285 ms), /browse/passports-citizenship-and-identity/ (6036 ms) and 8 more.
fix.fix: Profile those templates; they are slower than the rest of the site.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
